ctx.x: Willie Josephs You say Willie Josephs then was your brother. Is he a younger brother?

No, I have a younger brother who played music too in the country. Henry Josephs used to play with Phil Bonne William. Oh, yes. He played with Freddie Landry. I played with Freddie Landry. Freddie Landry played with Freddie Landry. After he got his own band.
And then your brother who died, what was his name? Willie Josephs. The other one?

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Sure. All them fellas. ... I know him where.

ctx.x: Freddie's in Donaldson Bay? All right. Donaldson Bay. We'll see you later. Okay, man. All right. Let's see you. Okay. Donaldson Bay. That's right. I've got his name now. All right.
Clifford General. Clifford General. So you remember Freddie Landry? Sullivan Sprawl? You remember him?

Sure. All them fellas. What did he play, Sullivan? Sullivan. He tried to play clarinet. Mm-hmm. He wasn't much on it. And let's see. Well, Miney was from up around there. Miney was on this side of the river. They was from the other side of the river. Oh. Miney was, yeah, Miney. I know him where. Miney John.
